item.title: Telegram CEO says 'takedown extortionist' was responsible for the app being briefly delisted by Apple
item.description: Pavel Durov claims there's "a potential systemic risk" for platforms with user-generated content.

item.title: The White House Is Keeping Its AI Cybersecurity Framework Secret
item.description: The Trump administration shared the details of its plan with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs on Tuesday. For now, the public remains in the dark.

item.title: Now you can securely link multiple phones to one Signal account
item.description: You can link more devices with one phone number on Signal now, including an Android phone or iPhone. Signal already supported linking PCs and iPads, but not additional phones. When you link a device on Signal, you can check and respond to new messages across all of your linked devices. You can also choose whether […]

item.title: 'Tools don't have independent values — their values are human values': Quote of the day by Stanford professor Fei-Fei Li on building ethical AI
item.description: Developing AI as a tool means recognizing that its values are reflected in the values of those who build and deploy it

item.title: Steam survey shows GPUs with 16GB are now the most popular graphics cards — and that really doesn't bode well for gamers' wallets
item.description: With more GPU price hikes apparently inbound, gamers are going to struggle to get the VRAM they crave.

item.title: Perplexity has successfully overturned Amazon's injunction on its AI shopping bot
item.description: Amazon's public fight with Perplexity over online shopping started in November 2025.

item.title: We just got our first real look at how small X's ad business is
item.description: Advertisers seem to be spending a whole lot less than they used to on the platform.

item.title: SpaceX's first public earnings statement shows the financials of an AI company in 2026
item.description: That's a lot of capital expenditure.

item.title: Beelink EQi Wildcat Lake review: Ultra-fast networking makes this mini PC a great office machine
item.description: The Beelink EQi is a compact Windows 11 Pro mini PC aimed at those looking for an office machine with decent network connection and fast connectivity.

item.title: SpaceX has bought $329M worth of Tesla Megapacks so far this year
item.description: The purchase illustrates just how interconnected Elon Musk's universe of companies are.

item.title: SpaceX rocket set to crash into the moon at seven times the speed of sound — but the 5,400 mph impact is entirely expected, and might even prove useful for NASA
item.description: A dead SpaceX upper stage is set to hit the Moon at 5,400 mph. Nobody planned it; everybody saw it coming, and two orbiters will be watching.

item.title: CMF's first clip-style open earbuds are here with a tempting price tag and, thankfully, none of Nothing's flagship surveillance tech
item.description: If the Nothing sub-brand's inaugural clip-style open earbuds can ace the ‘three point fit’ idea, I predict a class-leading set of LDAC-toting buds —especially for this crazy low price

item.title: AMD’s datacenter business is booming while gaming takes a backseat
item.description: Driven by demand for AI capacity, AMD's data center revenue more than doubled year-over-year in its latest earnings report, reaching $6.7 billion. That's up from $5.8 billion in Q1, and jumping 107 percent from the $3.2 billion it reported for the same period a year ago. At the same time, AMD's gaming revenue fell 31 […]

item.title: SpaceX posts strong revenue in first earnings report since IPO
item.description: Revenue jumped to $7.8 billion, up more than 90% from the year-earlier period. SpaceX reported it lost more than half a billion dollars in its first quarterly report as a public company, but the loss was less than Wall Street expected and revenue soared.

item.title: SpaceX made more revenue as an AI company than a space company
item.description: SpaceX's AI revenue grew more than three times to $2.6 billion from the year before, mostly because of deals that the company made to provide compute to other AI companies, according to SpaceX's quarterly earnings. The AI division, which the company said in its documents to go public was the source of most of its […]

item.title: Stripe CEO says his ‘urgency’ to drop out of MIT ‘was a bit unnecessary’
item.description: “In hindsight, I think that was a poor intuition,” Patrick Collison said during a Y Combinator interview. “It’s been pretty robustly and reliably the case over many decades that Silicon Valley has a surfeit of opportunities.” Patrick Collison dropped out of MIT twice before going on to become the cofounder and CEO of Stripe. In an interview at Y Combinator’s Startup School, Collison imparted some of his wisdom to the Gen Z founders in the crowd, including the advice to not feel pressured to make the same choice he made....

item.title: SpaceX doubles revenue on Anthropic and Google compute deals, Starlink growth
item.description: SpaceX doubled its revenue compared to last year, according to its first quarterly earnings since going public in June.

item.title: Texas, yes Texas, puts limits on data centers
item.description: Texas governor Greg Abbott announced new restrictions for new data center projects, requiring comprehensive state utility audits before they can proceed.

item.title: Whoop joins fellow premium screenless wearable company Oura in partnering with the Natural Cycles women's health tracking app
item.description: Whoop is partnering with the women's health tracking app to sync the tracker's data with its insights

item.title: Android app developers may be unwittingly sharing their users’ location data with advertisers
item.description: New findings by the Electronic Frontier Foundation aim to warn app developers that some of the third-party code they place in their apps may also collect their users' location data when they grant permission to the app.

item.title: EA is now a private company
item.description: Electronic Arts has officially become a private company. Last September, EA announced that an investor group led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners would be taking the company private in a $55 billion deal, and on Tuesday, EA said the deal successfully closed.
